WITH curr_exposure AS
            ( 
                    SELECT
             parent.party_name AS "party_name_parent",  
            parent.cppib_party_id AS "cppib_party_id_parent",  
            coalesce( parent_country.name, parent.domicile_country_code ) AS "country_code_parent",  
            parent.rtg_final AS "rtg_final_parent",  
            parent.rtg_outlook AS "rtg_outlook_parent",  
            child.party_name AS "party_name_child",  
                    child.cppib_party_id AS "cppib_party_id_child",  
            coalesce( child_country.name, child.domicile_country_code ) AS "country_code_child",  
            child.rtg_final AS "rtg_final_child",  
                    child.rtg_outlook AS "rtg_outlook_child",  
            SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND pos.days_to_maturity = 1 THEN fact.credit_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS "exposure_expiring",  
            SUM(  
                   CASE  
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND  
                   ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-29' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                   OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-29' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                   THEN fact.st_exposure
                   ELSE 0
                   END
            ) AS "st_exposure",
            child.st_cash_pb_fi_limit AS "st_smd_threshold",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
             ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-29' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                           OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-29' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                           THEN fact.mt_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "mt_exposure",
            child.mt_cash_pb_fi_limit AS "mt_smd_threshold",
                    SUM(
                            CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                            ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-29' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                            OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE p.business_date = '2025-05-29' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                            THEN fact.lt_exposure
                            ELSE 0
                            END
                    ) AS "lt_exposure",
            child.lt_cash_pb_fi_limit AS "lt_smd_threshold",
                    SUM(
                            CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                            ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-29' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                            OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-29' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                            THEN fact.credit_exposure
                            ELSE 0
                           END
                    ) AS "total_cash_pb_exposure",
            child.total_cash_pb_smd_fi_limit AS "total_cash_pb_smd_limit",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-29' and p.product_type_category = 'REPOS' AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "repo_sbl_exposure",
            child.repo_fi_limit AS "repo_sbl_smd_threshold",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-29' and p.product_type_category = 'DERIVATIVES' AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "der_exposure",
            child.der_fi_limit AS "der_smd_threshold",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-29' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "total_der_repo_sbl_exposure",
            child.der_repo_fi_limit AS "total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           (
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-29' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) OR
                            ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-29' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                            OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-29' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                           )
                           THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "isrc_total_exposure",
            child.isrc_total_fi_limit AS "isrc_total_limit",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           (
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-29' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) OR
                            ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-29' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                            OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-29' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                           )
                           THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "smd_total_exposure",
            child.smd_total_fi_limit AS smd_total_limit
            FROM dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child
            INNER JOIN fact_cr_exposure fact
            ON fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and fact.chron_id = child.chron_id
            INNER JOIN dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent
            ON child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and parent.chron_id = child.chron_id
            INNER JOIN dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos
            ON fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id and pos.chron_id = fact.chron_id
            LEFT OUTER JOIN ref_country parent_country
            ON parent.domicile_country_code = parent_country.alpha_2_code and parent.chron_id = parent_country.chron_id
            LEFT OUTER JOIN ref_country child_country
            ON child.domicile_country_code = child_country.alpha_2_code and child_country.chron_id = child.chron_id
            WHERE
            child.business_date = '2025-05-29'
            AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) <> 'NETTING'
            AND
                    (
                            parent.is_fi = 'Y'
                            OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
                            OR EXISTS
                                    (
                                            SELECT 1
                                            FROM dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
                                            WHERE
                                            sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                                            AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                                            AND sibling.chron_id = child.chron_id
                           AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
                    )
                )
            GROUP BY
            parent.party_name,
                    parent.cppib_party_id,
                    coalesce( parent_country.name, parent.domicile_country_code ),
                    parent.rtg_final,
                    parent.rtg_outlook,
                    child.party_name,
                    child.cppib_party_id,
                    coalesce( child_country.name, child.domicile_country_code ),
                    child.rtg_final,
                    child.rtg_outlook,
                    child.st_cash_pb_fi_limit,
                    child.mt_cash_pb_fi_limit,
                    child.lt_cash_pb_fi_limit,
                    child.total_cash_pb_smd_fi_limit,
                    child.repo_fi_limit,
                    child.der_fi_limit,
                    child.der_repo_fi_limit,
                    child.isrc_total_fi_limit,
                    child.smd_total_fi_limit
            ),
            child_level_exp_limits AS
            (
                    SELECT
            'N' AS "is_parent",
            party_name_child AS "entity_name",
                    party_name_parent AS "parent_name",
                    CASE
                           WHEN SUM( st_exposure ) >= MAX( st_smd_threshold ) THEN 'EXCESS'
                           WHEN SUM( mt_exposure ) >= MAX( mt_smd_threshold ) THEN 'EXCESS'
                           WHEN SUM( lt_exposure ) >= MAX( lt_smd_threshold ) THEN 'EXCESS'
                           WHEN SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) >= MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ) THEN 'EXCESS'
                           WHEN SUM( der_exposure ) >= MAX( der_smd_threshold ) THEN 'EXCESS'
                           WHEN SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) >= MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ) THEN 'BREACH'
                           WHEN SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) >= MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ) THEN 'BREACH'
                           WHEN SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) >= MAX( isrc_total_limit ) THEN 'BREACH'
                           WHEN SUM( smd_total_exposure ) >= MAX( smd_total_limit ) THEN 'BREACH'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ) / MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ) / MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ) / MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ) / MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ) / MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ) / MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) / MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) / MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) / MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) / MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ) / MAX( smd_total_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ) / MAX( smd_total_limit ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ) / MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ) / MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ) / MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ) / MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ) / MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ) / MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) / MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) / MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) / MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) / MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ) / MAX( smd_total_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ) / MAX( smd_total_limit ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
            ELSE 'OK'
            END AS "status",
                   country_code_child,
                    coalesce( rtg_final_child, '-' ) AS "rtg_final",
            coalesce( rtg_outlook_child, '-' ) AS "rtg_outlook",
            CAST (ROUND( SUM( exposure_expiring ), 2 )AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "exposure_expiring",
            CAST (ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ), 2 )AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "st_exposure",
            coalesce( CAST (ROUND( MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "st_smd_threshold",
            coalesce( CAST (ROUND( MAX( st_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( st_exposure ) ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) , '-')
            AS "st_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "mt_exposure",
            coalesce( CAST (ROUND( MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "mt_smd_threshold",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( mt_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( mt_exposure ) ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-')
            AS "mt_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ), 2)  AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "lt_exposure",
            coalesce( CAST (ROUND( MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "lt_smd_threshold",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( lt_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( lt_exposure ) ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-')
            AS "lt_available",
                    /* Comment this out until GCM can handle these new fields after July 7, 2017 Abacus 3.1 release */
                   coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "total_cash_pb_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 2 )AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "total_cash_pb_smd_limit",
            coalesce( CAST (ROUND( MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) ), 2 )AS VARCHAR(255)), '-')
            AS "total_cash_pb_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "repo_sbl_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "repo_sbl_smd_threshold",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )
            AS "repo_sbl_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "der_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "der_smd_threshold",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( der_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( der_exposure ) ), 2 )AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )
            AS "der_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "total_der_repo_sbl_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-')
            AS "total_der_repo_sbl_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "isrc_total_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "isrc_total_limit",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( isrc_total_limit ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) ), 2 )AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )
            AS "isrc_total_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "smd_total_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( smd_total_limit ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "smd_total_limit",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( smd_total_limit ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( smd_total_exposure ) ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )
            AS "smd_total_available",
                    cppib_party_id_child,
                   cppib_party_id_parent
            FROM curr_exposure c
            GROUP BY
            party_name_child, party_name_parent, country_code_child, rtg_final_child, rtg_outlook_child,
    cppib_party_id_child, cppib_party_id_parent--, 'N', coalesce( rtg_final_child, '0' ), coalesce( rtg_outlook_child, '0' )
            ),
            breaches_under_parents_tbl AS
            (
                    SELECT
            cppib_party_id,
                --MIN( status ) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY LENGTH( status ) DESC) AS status
               DENSE_RANK () OVER(ORDER BY LENGTH(status) DESC) as state, status
             --MIN(STATUS) as STATUS
            FROM
                    (
                            SELECT

                           OR ((NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_der_repo_sbl_exposure,'\-')) and (NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,'\-')) and (CAST(total_der_repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL) >= CAST(total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit AS DECIMAL)) )
                           OR ((NOT REGEXP_LIKE(isrc_total_limit,'\-')) and (NOT REGEXP_LIKE(isrc_total_exposure,'\-')) and (CAST(isrc_total_exposure AS DECIMAL) >= CAST(isrc_total_limit AS DECIMAL)))
                           OR ((NOT REGEXP_LIKE(smd_total_limit,'\-')) and (NOT REGEXP_LIKE(smd_total_exposure,'\-')) and (CAST(smd_total_exposure AS DECIMAL) >= CAST(smd_total_limit AS DECIMAL))) THEN 'BREACH'

                          WHEN ((NOT REGEXP_LIKE(der_smd_threshold,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(der_smd_threshold,'\-') and (CAST (der_exposure AS DECIMAL) >= CAST(der_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL))) OR (NOT REGEXP_LIKE(repo_sbl_smd_threshold,'\-') AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(repo_sbl_exposure,'\-') AND (CAST(repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL ) >= CAST(repo_sbl_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL)))) THEN 'EXCESS'
                          WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_cash_pb_exposure,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_cash_pb_smd_limit,'\-') and ( CAST (total_cash_pb_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (total_cash_pb_smd_limit AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST(total_cash_pb_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (total_cash_pb_smd_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( CAST(total_cash_pb_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (total_cash_pb_smd_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_der_repo_sbl_exposure,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,'\-') and ( CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND(CAST  (total_der_repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND(CAST  (total_der_repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(isrc_total_limit,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(isrc_total_exposure,'\-') and ( CAST (isrc_total_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (isrc_total_limit AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST (isrc_total_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (isrc_total_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( CAST (isrc_total_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (isrc_total_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(smd_total_limit,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(smd_total_exposure,'\-') and ( CAST (smd_total_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (smd_total_limit AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST (smd_total_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (smd_total_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( CAST (smd_total_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (smd_total_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(der_smd_threshold,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(der_exposure,'\-') and ( CAST (der_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (der_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST (der_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (der_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( CAST (der_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (der_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(repo_sbl_smd_threshold,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(repo_sbl_exposure,'\-') and ( CAST (repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (repo_sbl_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST (repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (repo_sbl_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( CAST (repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (repo_sbl_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_cash_pb_exposure,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_cash_pb_smd_limit,'\-') and ( CAST (total_cash_pb_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (total_cash_pb_smd_limit AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST (total_cash_pb_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (total_cash_pb_smd_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( CAST (total_cash_pb_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (total_cash_pb_smd_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_der_repo_sbl_exposure,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,'\-') and ( CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(isrc_total_limit,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(isrc_total_exposure,'\-') and ( CAST (isrc_total_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (isrc_total_limit AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST (isrc_total_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (isrc_total_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( CAST (isrc_total_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (isrc_total_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(smd_total_limit,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(smd_total_exposure,'\-') and ( CAST (smd_total_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (smd_total_limit AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST (smd_total_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (smd_total_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( CAST (smd_total_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (smd_total_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                          WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(der_smd_threshold,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(der_exposure,'\-') and ( CAST (der_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (der_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST (der_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (der_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( CAST (der_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (der_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(repo_sbl_smd_threshold,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_cash_pb_smd_limit,'\-') and ( CAST (repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (repo_sbl_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST (repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (repo_sbl_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( CAST (repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (repo_sbl_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
            ELSE 'OK'
            END AS status
            FROM child_level_exp_limits
             ) p
            GROUP BY cppib_party_id, status
            ), breaches_under_parents as (select cppib_party_id, MIN(status) as status FROM breaches_under_parents_tbl where state = 1 GROUP BY cppib_party_id)
            SELECT
            'Y' AS "is_parent",
            party_name_parent AS "entity_name",
                           party_name_parent AS "parent_name",
                   CASE
                           WHEN b.status = 'EXCESS'
                           OR SUM( der_exposure ) >= MAX( der_smd_threshold )
                           OR SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) >= MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold )
                           OR SUM( st_exposure ) >= MAX( st_smd_threshold )
                           OR SUM( mt_exposure ) >= MAX( mt_smd_threshold )
                           OR SUM( lt_exposure ) >= MAX( lt_smd_threshold )
                           THEN 'EXCESS'
                           WHEN b.status = 'BREACH'
                           OR SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) >= MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit )
                           OR SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) >= MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit )
                           OR SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) >= MAX( isrc_total_limit )
                           OR SUM( smd_total_exposure ) >= MAX( smd_total_limit )
                           THEN 'BREACH'
                           WHEN b.status = 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) )
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ) / MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ) / MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) )
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ) / MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ) / MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) )
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ) / MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ) / MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) )
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) )
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) / MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) / MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) )
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) )
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) / MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) / MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) )
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ) / MAX( smd_total_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ) / MAX( smd_total_limit ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) )
                           THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN b.status = 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) )
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ) / MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ) / MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) )
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ) / MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ) / MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) )
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ) / MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ) / MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) )
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) )
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) / MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) / MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) )
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) )
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) / MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) / MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) )
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ) / MAX( smd_total_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ) / MAX( smd_total_limit ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) )
                           THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
            ELSE 'OK'
            END AS "status",
                    country_code_parent,
                           coalesce( rtg_final_parent, '-' ) AS "rtg_final",
            coalesce( rtg_outlook_parent, '-' ) AS "rtg_outlook",
            CAST (ROUND( SUM( exposure_expiring ), 2)  AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "exposure_expiring",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "st_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "st_smd_threshold",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( st_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( st_exposure ) ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )
            AS "st_available",
                           coalesce( CAST (ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "mt_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "mt_smd_threshold",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( mt_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( mt_exposure ) ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-')
            AS "mt_available",
                            coalesce( CAST (ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "lt_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "lt_smd_threshold",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( lt_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( lt_exposure ) ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )
            AS "lt_available",
                    /* Comment this out until GCM can handle these new fields after July 7, 2017 Abacus 3.1 release */
                           coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "total_cash_pb_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "total_cash_pb_smd_limit",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) ), 2 )   AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )
            AS "total_cash_pb_available",
                           coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "repo_sbl_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "repo_sbl_smd_threshold",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )
            AS "repo_sbl_available",
                           coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "der_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "der_smd_threshold",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( der_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( der_exposure ) ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )
            AS "der_available",

            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )
            AS "total_der_repo_sbl_available",
                           coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "isrc_total_exposure",
             coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "isrc_total_limit",
             coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( isrc_total_limit ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )

             coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( smd_total_limit ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( smd_total_exposure ) ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )

WITH curr_exposure AS
            ( 
                    SELECT
             parent.party_name AS "party_name_parent",

            SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND pos.days_to_maturity = 1 THEN fact.credit_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS "exposure_expiring",

                   THEN fact.st_exposure
                   ELSE 0
                   END
            ) AS "st_exposure",
            child.st_cash_pb_fi_limit AS "st_smd_threshold",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
             ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-29' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                           OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-29' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )

                            CASE

                            OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE p.business_date = '2025-05-29' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )

                            OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-29' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )

                            ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-29' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                            OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-29' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )

                            ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-29' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )

            child.smd_total_fi_limit AS smd_total_limit

                          WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_cash_pb_exposure,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_cash_pb_smd_limit,'\-') and ( CAST (total_cash_pb_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (total_cash_pb_smd_limit AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST(total_cash_pb_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (total_cash_pb_smd_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( CAST(total_cash_pb_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (total_cash_pb_smd_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'

                           WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(isrc_total_limit,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(isrc_total_exposure,'\-') and ( CAST (isrc_total_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (isrc_total_limit AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST (isrc_total_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (isrc_total_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( CAST (isrc_total_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (isrc_total_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'

            (

                   OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-29' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                   THEN fact.st_exposure

                   SUM(
                           CASE

/* cppi::d7cb1ce7f1c07d3a4d063bedc3fde439937c834a9a7bb2fc56ab0de8a1298919 */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 02
		AND hour between 09 and 10
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-02 09:11:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 02
		AND hour between 08 and 09
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-02 08:31:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

left join risk_prod.cppib_security_rating csr on cast(csr.cppib_sec_id as varchar) = dpi.cppib_security_id and csr.business_date = dpi.business_date
left join risk_prod.cppib_party_rating cpr on cpr.cppib_party_id = i_rle.cppib_party_id and cpr.business_date = dpi.business_date
left join dv01 on dv01.pos_id = dpi.pos_id

/* QuickSight */
SELECT ds.* FROM ( -- Final SQL: Department/Strategy/Program view with Core Pool AUM and % of core, filtered to dates after 2020-04-01

WITH base_data AS (
    SELECT 
        r.*,
        date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS parsed_date,
        CASE
            WHEN month(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (4,5,6)
                THEN cast(year(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) + 1 AS varchar) || 'Q1'
            WHEN month(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (7,8,9)
                THEN cast(year(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) + 1 AS varchar) || 'Q2'
            WHEN month(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (10,11,12)
                THEN cast(year(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) + 1 AS varchar) || 'Q3'
            ELSE cast(year(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) AS varchar) || 'Q4'
        END AS fiscal_quarter_key
    FROM risk_prod.rmv_analytics r
    WHERE r.portfolio_type = 'IP'
      AND r.hierarchy_type = 'RISK'
      AND r.hierarchy_level IN ('DEPARTMENT', 'STRATEGY', 'PROGRAM')
      AND (
            r.analytic_type IN ('PV', 'VOLATILITY_10YR')
            OR (
                r.analytic_type IN ('VAR_10YR', 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR')
                AND r.confidence_level = 0.95
            )
        )
      AND date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') >= date '2020-04-01'
),

quarter_end_dates AS (
    SELECT fiscal_quarter_key, MAX(parsed_date) AS quarter_end_date
    FROM base_data
    WHERE month(parsed_date) IN (3, 6, 9, 12)
    GROUP BY fiscal_quarter_key
),

core_pool AS (
    SELECT 
        date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS parsed_date,
        SUM(market_value_qc) AS core_pool_aum
    FROM risk_prod.ref_fund_unitization
    WHERE fund_code = 'CORE'
    GROUP BY date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')
),

filtered AS (
    SELECT 
        d.*,
        CASE 
            WHEN d.parsed_date = q.quarter_end_date THEN 
                'F' || substr(d.fiscal_quarter_key, 3, 2) || ' ' || substr(d.fiscal_quarter_key, 5, 2)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS fiscal_quarter,
        cp.core_pool_aum
    FROM base_data d
    LEFT JOIN quarter_end_dates q 
        ON d.fiscal_quarter_key = q.fiscal_quarter_key AND d.parsed_date = q.quarter_end_date
    LEFT JOIN core_pool cp 
        ON d.parsed_date = cp.parsed_date
),

department_agg AS (
    SELECT
        parsed_date AS business_date,
        fiscal_quarter,
        COALESCE(department, 'CPPIB-ALL') AS department,
        COALESCE(department, 'CPPIB-ALL') AS display_strategy,
        'department' AS level,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS pv,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS vol_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS var_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS es_10yr,
        MAX(core_pool_aum) AS core_pool_aum
    FROM filtered
    WHERE hierarchy_level = 'DEPARTMENT'
    GROUP BY parsed_date, fiscal_quarter, COALESCE(department, 'CPPIB-ALL')
),

department_final AS (
    SELECT *,
        CASE 
            WHEN department IN ('Credit Investments', 'Private Equity', 'Real Assets') 
            THEN pv / NULLIF(core_pool_aum, 0)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS pct_of_core
    FROM department_agg
),

cppib_all_row AS (
    SELECT
        parsed_date AS business_date,
        fiscal_quarter,
        'CPPIB-ALL' AS department,
        'CPPIB-ALL' AS display_strategy,
        'department' AS level,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS pv,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS vol_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS var_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS es_10yr,
        MAX(core_pool_aum) AS core_pool_aum,
        NULL AS pct_of_core
    FROM filtered
    WHERE hierarchy_level = 'DEPARTMENT'
    GROUP BY parsed_date, fiscal_quarter
),

strategy_agg AS (
    SELECT
        parsed_date AS business_date,
        fiscal_quarter,
        COALESCE(department, 'CPPIB-ALL') AS department,
        CASE 
            WHEN strategy = 'Real_Estate' THEN 'Real Estate'
            ELSE strategy
        END AS display_strategy,
        'strategy' AS level,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS pv,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS vol_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS var_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS es_10yr,
        NULL AS core_pool_aum,
        NULL AS pct_of_core
    FROM filtered
    WHERE hierarchy_level = 'STRATEGY'
    GROUP BY parsed_date, fiscal_quarter, department, strategy
),

program_agg AS (
    SELECT
        parsed_date AS business_date,
        fiscal_quarter,
        COALESCE(department, 'CPPIB-ALL') AS department,
        program AS display_strategy,
        'program' AS level,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS pv,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS vol_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS var_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS es_10yr,
        NULL AS core_pool_aum,
        NULL AS pct_of_core
    FROM filtered
    WHERE hierarchy_level = 'PROGRAM'
    GROUP BY parsed_date, fiscal_quarter, department, program
)

-- Final output
SELECT * FROM department_final
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM cppib_all_row
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM strategy_agg
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM program_agg ) ds LIMIT 0

    WHERE r.portfolio_type = 'IP'
      AND r.hierarchy_type = 'RISK'
      AND r.hierarchy_level IN ('DEPARTMENT', 'STRATEGY', 'PROGRAM')
      AND (
            r.analytic_type IN ('PV', 'VOLATILITY_10YR')
            OR (
                r.analytic_type IN ('VAR_10YR', 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR')
                AND r.confidence_level = 0.95
            )
        )
      AND date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') >= date '2020-04-01'
),

quarter_end_dates AS (
    SELECT fiscal_quarter_key, MAX(parsed_date) AS quarter_end_date
    FROM base_data
    WHERE month(parsed_date) IN (3, 6, 9, 12)
    GROUP BY fiscal_quarter_key
),

core_pool AS (
    SELECT 
        date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS parsed_date,
        SUM(market_value_qc) AS core_pool_aum
    FROM risk_prod.ref_fund_unitization
    WHERE fund_code = 'CORE'
    GROUP BY date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')
),

filtered AS (
    SELECT 
        d.*,
        CASE 
            WHEN d.parsed_date = q.quarter_end_date THEN 
                'F' || substr(d.fiscal_quarter_key, 3, 2) || ' ' || substr(d.fiscal_quarter_key, 5, 2)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS fiscal_quarter,
        cp.core_pool_aum
    FROM base_data d
    LEFT JOIN quarter_end_dates q 
        ON d.fiscal_quarter_key = q.fiscal_quarter_key AND d.parsed_date = q.quarter_end_date
    LEFT JOIN core_pool cp 
        ON d.parsed_date = cp.parsed_date
),

department_agg AS (
    SELECT
        parsed_date AS business_date,
        fiscal_quarter,
        COALESCE(department, 'CPPIB-ALL') AS department,
        COALESCE(department, 'CPPIB-ALL') AS display_strategy,
        'department' AS level,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS pv,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS vol_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS var_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS es_10yr,
        MAX(core_pool_aum) AS core_pool_aum
    FROM filtered
    WHERE hierarchy_level = 'DEPARTMENT'
    GROUP BY parsed_date, fiscal_quarter, COALESCE(department, 'CPPIB-ALL')
),

department_final AS (
    SELECT *,
        CASE 
            WHEN department IN ('Credit Investments', 'Private Equity', 'Real Assets') 
            THEN pv / NULLIF(core_pool_aum, 0)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS pct_of_core
    FROM department_agg
),

cppib_all_row AS (
    SELECT
        parsed_date AS business_date,
        fiscal_quarter,
        'CPPIB-ALL' AS department,
        'CPPIB-ALL' AS display_strategy,
        'department' AS level,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS pv,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS vol_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS var_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS es_10yr,
        MAX(core_pool_aum) AS core_pool_aum,
        NULL AS pct_of_core
    FROM filtered
    WHERE hierarchy_level = 'DEPARTMENT'
    GROUP BY parsed_date, fiscal_quarter
),

strategy_agg AS (
    SELECT
        parsed_date AS business_date,
        fiscal_quarter,
        COALESCE(department, 'CPPIB-ALL') AS department,
        CASE 
            WHEN strategy = 'Real_Estate' THEN 'Real Estate'
            ELSE strategy
        END AS display_strategy,
        'strategy' AS level,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS pv,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS vol_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS var_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS es_10yr,
        NULL AS core_pool_aum,
        NULL AS pct_of_core
    FROM filtered
    WHERE hierarchy_level = 'STRATEGY'
    GROUP BY parsed_date, fiscal_quarter, department, strategy
),

program_agg AS (
    SELECT
        parsed_date AS business_date,
        fiscal_quarter,
        COALESCE(department, 'CPPIB-ALL') AS department,
        program AS display_strategy,
        'program' AS level,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS pv,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS vol_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS var_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS es_10yr,
        NULL AS core_pool_aum,
        NULL AS pct_of_core
    FROM filtered
    WHERE hierarchy_level = 'PROGRAM'
    GROUP BY parsed_date, fiscal_quarter, department, program
)

-- Final output
SELECT * FROM department_final
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM cppib_all_row
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM strategy_agg
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM program_agg ) ds LIMIT 0

SELECT ds.* FROM ( select 
  lt.business_date,
  --ist.investmentstructurelevel1, --add all investment strucutre levels
  lt.pool_name,
  lt.id_model_portfolio,
  mp.model_portfolio_name,
  --add model portfolio table
  ist.investmentstructurelevel2,
  uppcc.epm_party_name as ultimate_parent_party_name,
  lt.parent_security_type_name,
  lt.parent_security_name,
  lt.security_type_name,
  lt.security_name,
  secc.cppib_currency_of_exposure_name as "Security Currency of Exposure",
  secc.cppib_country_of_exposure_name  as "Security Country of Exposure",
  lt.total_market_value_pc,
  lt.total_market_value_qc,
  lt.balance_nominal,
  lt.leg_no
from holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough lt  
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite secc 
  on lt.enterprise_security_id = secc.enterprise_security_id
  and lt.business_date = secc.business_date
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite pcc 
  on secc.enterprise_party_id = pcc.enterprise_party_id
  and pcc.business_date = secc.business_date
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite uppcc 
  on pcc.ultimate_parent_enterprise_party_id = uppcc.enterprise_party_id
  and uppcc.business_date = pcc.business_date
left join performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten ist
on ist.model_portfolio = lt.id_model_portfolio 
and ist.business_date = cast(lt.business_date as varchar)
left join reference.scd_model_portfolio mp 
  on lt.id_model_portfolio = mp.model_portfolio_id
  and mp.business_date = (
    select max(business_date) 
    from reference.scd_model_portfolio
  )
where lt.business_date > date('2025-03-31') ) ds LIMIT 0

SELECT *

				    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
				    grouped_usd,
				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date

						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date

						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date

						SELECT erc.data_date AS date,

SELECT * FROM (WITH params AS (
            SELECT from_iso8601_date( NULL ) AS query_date
        ),
	adjusted_date AS (
		SELECT
			query_date,
			CASE
				WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 1 THEN query_date - interval '3' day
				WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 7 THEN query_date - interval '1' day
				ELSE query_date - interval '1' day
				END AS business_date
		FROM params
	),
     account_mapping_query AS (
         SELECT
             date_format(ad.query_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS BUSINESS_DATE,
             pam.mx_portfolio_id AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
             pam.bbg_pfolio_id AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
             pam.model_portfolio AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
             pam.sst_account AS SST_ACCOUNT
         FROM reference.model_portfolio_account_mapping pam
                  JOIN adjusted_date ad ON pam.as_of_date = ad.business_date
             )
        SELECT
            COALESCE(BUSINESS_DATE, '') as BUSINESS_DATE,
            COALESCE(TRIM(MUREX_PORTOFOLIO), '') as MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
            COALESCE(TRIM(BBG_ACCOUNT), '') as BBG_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(SCD_ACCOUNT), '') as SCD_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(SST_ACCOUNT), '') as SST_ACCOUNT
        FROM account_mapping_query
        UNION
        SELECT
            date_format(ad.query_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS BUSINESS_DATE,
            '' AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
            '' AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(scd.model_portfolio_id), '') AS SCD_ACCOUNT,

/* cppi::b716d8c8f86ed7841551d910b4ad59049090baf1216b79d87935090bd0282dc3 */
--select SECURITIES_SECSHORT from (
SELECT h.model_portfolio_id AS MPDEFS_MP,
h.abor_security_id AS SECURITIES_SECSHORT,
MAX(CASE WHEN h.balance_nominal_number >= 0 THEN h.balance_nominal_number END) AS PFCHOLDINGS_BALNOMVALP,
MAX(CASE WHEN h.balance_nominal_number < 0 THEN -1 * h.balance_nominal_number END) AS PFCHOLDINGS_BALNOMVALS,
t.party_name AS PARTNERS_BROKERNAME,
t.trade_date AS SECURITIES_ISSDATE,
h.abor_maturity_date AS PFCKEYRATIOS_MATDATE,
h.portfolio_id AS PORTFOLIOS_POR,
MAX(CASE WHEN h.balance_nominal_number >= 0 THEN h.quotation_currency_code ELSE NULL END) AS HOLKEYS_QUOCURP,
h.security_group_id AS SECGROUPS_SECGRP,
MAX(CASE WHEN h.balance_nominal_number < 0 THEN h.quotation_currency_code ELSE NULL END) AS HOLKEYS_QUOCURS,
SUM(h.unrealised_pnl_book_currency_portfolio_currency + h.unrealised_pnl_book_security_portfolio_currency) AS PFCKEYRATIOS_CLEANVALPCT,
h.portfolio_group_name AS PORTGROUPS_PORGRP
from holdings.scd_holdings_main h
JOIN (
select DISTINCT t.abor_security_id , t.trade_date, p.party_name
from trades_deals.scd_transactions t
join reference.scd_party_issuer p on  t.counterparty_id = p.scd_party_id
where 1=1
--and t.business_transaction_code in ('SellFXFwdDbd','BuyFXFwdDbd','InitHoldNom','InitHold')
--and t.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
) t ON h.abor_security_id = t.abor_security_id
WHERE h.business_date = '2025-05-30'--BUSINESS_DATE''
and (t.party_name not LIKE 'INTERNAL CPTY%' and trim(h.portfolio_id) in ('PARENT', 'S PARENT')
or (trim(h.portfolio_id) = 'S PARENT' and t.party_name LIKE 'INTERNAL CPTY%'))
and h.security_group_id in ('FXFORWARD', 'FXNDF')
--and h.abor_security_id = 'FXF1272282'
and h.model_portfolio_id != 'MPDEFS_MP'
and h.balance_nominal_number != 0
GROUP BY
h.model_portfolio_id,
h.abor_security_id,
t.party_name,
t.trade_date,
h.abor_maturity_date,
h.portfolio_id,
h.security_group_id,
h.portfolio_group_name
--)order by 1

/* cppi::b69581d08998cf4be668d6fa2bca0d3becbd47144b468f052c89c6a4042919da */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 02
		AND hour between 00 and 01
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-02 00:00:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

var.hierarchy_node,

CAST(c.vol AS decimal(22,6)) as vol,
CAST(d.cs01 AS decimal(22,6)) as cs01,
CAST(e.dv01 AS decimal(22,6)) as dv01,
CAST(f.pv AS decimal(22,6)) as pv
from (
select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, analytic_value as "var95", run_id from

( select run_id from dag_runs where dag_id = 'active_risk_dag' and business_date = '2025-05-30')
) as var
left join 
(select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, analytic_value as "mean", run_id from

(
select benchmark_name,  hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, sum(total) as cs01, run_id

radar_reporting_uat.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_dv01

/* cppi::b1027f4d418c911e00ef5ad51130500e9d58c49c3bb7e0d8d6bac8f7f6da311d */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND (
			(day = 01 AND hour >= 23)
			OR (day = 02 AND hour <= 00)
		)

	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01 23:25:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::98bcf4f445563487a88df5e0cf44153b472518dd23f28332df44e6f0df35a673 */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 02
		AND hour between 16 and 17
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-02 16:11:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::e367997160fe1ce331670bda800dc98fff2d6db85414077b814fc4c00f66cc8c */
SELECT  
    psl.aggregation_level_1 AS "Model Portfolio Code",
    ist.InvestmentStructureLevel2 AS "Investment Structure Level 02",
    ist.InvestmentStructureLevel3 AS "Investment Structure Level 03",
    ist.InvestmentStructureLevel4 AS "Investment Structure Level 04",
    s.abor_instrument_type_id AS "Instrument Type Name - Current",
    s.abor_security_type_name AS "Security Type Name - Current",
    s.abor_security_group_name AS "Security Group Name - Current",
    s.abor_security_name_id AS "Security Name - Current",
    psl.aggregation_level_3 AS "Security ID - Current",
    psl.business_date AS "Frequency Period",
    pa.secpnl AS "Security PnL PC",
    pa.fxpnl AS "FX PnL PC",
    pa.totpnl AS "Total PnL PC"
FROM
    performance.scd_performance_seclvl psl
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT * FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten 
    WHERE investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
    AND business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten)
) ist
ON psl.aggregation_level_1 = ist.model_portfolio
LEFT JOIN 
    reference.scd_securities s 
        ON s.abor_security_id = psl.aggregation_level_3 
        AND s.business_date = psl.business_date
LEFT JOIN 
    reference.scd_model_portfolio mp 
        ON psl.aggregation_level_1 = mp.model_portfolio_id 
        AND mp.business_date = psl.business_date
LEFT JOIN 
    asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications asec 
        ON asec.cppib_sec_id = CAST(s.cppib_sec_id AS int) 
        AND asec.business_date = CAST(psl.business_date AS DATE)
LEFT JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            model_portfolio_code,
            security_no,
            security_id,
            business_date,
            currency,
            SUM(pnl_currency_exposure_fx) AS fxpnl,
            sum(pnl_local_exposure_fx) as secpnl,
            sum(pnl_cad) as totpnl
        FROM 
            performance.pace_holding_pnl
        GROUP BY 
            model_portfolio_code,
            security_no,
            security_id,
            business_date, 
            currency
    ) pa
on psl.aggregation_level_3 = pa.security_id
	and psl.aggregation_level_1 =pa.model_portfolio_code
	and date(psl.business_date) = pa.business_date
	and psl.aggregation_level_2 =pa.currency
WHERE 
    psl.business_date BETWEEN '2025-03-01' AND '2025-03-31'
    AND ist.InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Total Fund Management'
    AND pa.secpnl <> 0
    AND s.abor_instrument_type_id IN ('Bond', 'CD', 'CP')

SELECT ctev.companyid, companyname, business_description, yearfounded, webpage, ticker,
            country, countrycode, city, region,
            simpleindustryid, simpleindustry,
            pricingdate, TEV, tev_currency,

            FROM
                (SELECT c.companyid, c.companyname, bd.business_description,
                                c.yearfounded, c.webpage,
                                ti.tickersymbol||':'||e.exchange_symbol AS ticker,
                                g.country, g.iso_country_2 AS countrycode, c.city, g.region,
                                c.simpleindustryid,
                                si.simple_industry_description AS simpleindustry,
                                mc.pricingdate,
                                max(pricingdate) over (PARTITION BY c.companyid) AS maxpricingdate,
                                mc.TEV, cur.isocode AS tev_currency
                            FROM capiq_company c
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_business_description bd ON
                                c.companyid = bd.company_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqsimpleindustry si ON
                                c.simpleindustryid = si.simple_industry_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqcountrygeo g ON c.countryid = g.country_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqMarketCap mc ON c.companyid = mc.companyid
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqSecurity s ON mc.companyId=s.companyId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_exchange e ON e.exchange_id = ti.exchangeId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqCurrency cur ON ti.currencyId=cur.currencyId
                            WHERE s.primaryFlag=1
                                AND ti.primaryFlag=1
                                AND simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                                AND companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating
                                                                -- 2=Operating Subsidiary
                                AND companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                                AND ((mc.TEV > 0 and cur.isocode is not null) OR mc.TEV IS NULL)
                                AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%6'
                )
            WHERE pricingdate=maxpricingdate
            ) AS ctev
            LEFT JOIN
            (-- Get LTM fundamentals for Public operating companies
            SELECT DISTINCT company_id,
                period_end_date, capiq_item, value_ltm, kpi_currency

                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqCurrency cur ON ti.currencyId=cur.currencyId
                WHERE c.simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                    AND c.companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating 2=Operating Subsidiary
                    AND c.companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public

            LEFT JOIN

            from (select o.company_id, c.companyname as company_name,

                        as max_period_end_date
                from cppib_party_ownership_pit_capiq o
                    left join capiq_company c on o.company_id = c.companyid
                    left join capiq_company i on o.owner_object_id = i.companyid

                    AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%6'
            )
        where period_end_date = max_period_end_date) AS ci
            ON ctev.companyid = ci.company_id

            country, countrycode, city, region,
            simpleindustryid, simpleindustry,
            pricingdate, TEV, tev_currency,
            cf.period_end_date, capiq_item, value_ltm, kpi_currency,
            investor_id, investor_name, ci.period_end_date as investment_period_end_date,
            percent_of_shares_outstanding as investor_percent_of_shares,
            rank_of_shares_held as investor_rank_of_shares_held
            FROM
            (-- Get company data +TEV
            SELECT companyid, companyname, business_description, yearfounded, webpage, ticker,
                            country, countrycode, city, region,
                            simpleindustryid, simpleindustry,
                            pricingdate, TEV, tev_currency
            FROM
                (SELECT c.companyid, c.companyname, bd.business_description,
                                c.yearfounded, c.webpage,
                                ti.tickersymbol||':'||e.exchange_symbol AS ticker,
                                g.country, g.iso_country_2 AS countrycode, c.city, g.region,
                                c.simpleindustryid,
                                si.simple_industry_description AS simpleindustry,
                                mc.pricingdate,
                                max(pricingdate) over (PARTITION BY c.companyid) AS maxpricingdate,
                                mc.TEV, cur.isocode AS tev_currency
                            FROM capiq_company c
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_business_description bd ON
                                c.companyid = bd.company_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqsimpleindustry si ON
                                c.simpleindustryid = si.simple_industry_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqcountrygeo g ON c.countryid = g.country_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqMarketCap mc ON c.companyid = mc.companyid
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqSecurity s ON mc.companyId=s.companyId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_exchange e ON e.exchange_id = ti.exchangeId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqCurrency cur ON ti.currencyId=cur.currencyId
                            WHERE s.primaryFlag=1
                                AND ti.primaryFlag=1
                                AND simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                                AND companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating
                                                                -- 2=Operating Subsidiary
                                AND companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                                AND ((mc.TEV > 0 and cur.isocode is not null) OR mc.TEV IS NULL)
                                AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%6'
                )
            WHERE pricingdate=maxpricingdate
            ) AS ctev
            LEFT JOIN
            (-- Get LTM fundamentals for Public operating companies
            SELECT DISTINCT company_id,
                period_end_date, capiq_item, value_ltm, kpi_currency
            FROM
                (SELECT f.company_id,
                    max(fiscal_chain_id) over (PARTITION BY f.company_id) AS maxfiscalchainid,
                    fiscal_chain_id,
                    max(period_end_date) over (PARTITION BY f.company_id) AS maxperiodenddate,
                    period_end_date,
                    CASE capiq_item_id
                        WHEN 112 THEN 'LTM_Revenue'
                        WHEN 4051 THEN 'LTM_EBITDA'
                    END AS capiq_item,
                    value_ltm, f.currency AS kpi_currency
                FROM cppib_party_fundamental_pit_capiq f
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_company c ON f.company_id = c.companyid
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqSecurity s ON f.company_id=s.companyId
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqCurrency cur ON ti.currencyId=cur.currencyId
                WHERE c.simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                    AND c.companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating 2=Operating Subsidiary
                    AND c.companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public

                    AND ti.primaryFlag=1
                    AND f.pit_date = '2025-06-01'
                    AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%6'
                )

                fiscal_chain_id = maxfiscalchainid AND
                capiq_item IS NOT NULL

            ON ctev.companyid = cf.company_id
            LEFT JOIN
            (select company_id, company_name, investor_id, investor_name, period_end_date,
                    percent_of_shares_outstanding, rank_of_shares_held
            from (select o.company_id, c.companyname as company_name,
                        o.owner_object_id as investor_id,
                        i.companyname as investor_name, o.period_end_date,
                        o.percent_of_shares_outstanding,
                        o.rank_of_shares_held,
                        max(period_end_date) over (partition by o.company_id)
                        as max_period_end_date
                from cppib_party_ownership_pit_capiq o
                    left join capiq_company c on o.company_id = c.companyid
                    left join capiq_company i on o.owner_object_id = i.companyid
                where pit_date_str = '2025-04-14'
                    and o.is_latest_flag = 1
                    AND o.rank_of_shares_held IS NOT NULL
                    AND o.rank_of_shares_held <6
                    AND c.simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                    AND c.companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating 2=Operating Subsidiary
                    AND c.companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                    AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%6'
            )
        where period_end_date = max_period_end_date) AS ci
            ON ctev.companyid = ci.company_id

    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND', 'FUT_EQT', 'FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND', 'FUT_EQT', 'FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND', 'FUT_EQT', 'FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND', 'FUT_EQT', 'FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long'
    ELSE NULL
END AS "Contract_Direction"

,CASE WHEN l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short' WHEN l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long'
      ELSE NULL END AS "Leg_Direction"
,l.underlying_index_name AS "Underlying_Index"

,case when m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' then concat(l.parent_security_number,'_1L0',cast(l.leg_no as varchar))
      when m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no = 1 THEN concat('CPP',cast(esmv.cppib_sec_id as varchar))
      when m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN concat('CPP',cast(ai2.cppib_sec_id as varchar))
      when m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.holding_level = 'Look Through' THEN
               concat('CPP',coalesce(cast(esmv.cppib_sec_id as varchar),cast(ai2.cppib_sec_id as varchar)))
      when m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.holding_level != 'Look Through' THEN l.parent_security_number
      when m.abor_security_type_id='CDS' AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.cppib_sec_id != 'Not Applicable' THEN concat('CPP',l.cppib_sec_id)
      when m.abor_security_type_id='CDS' AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN concat(l.parent_security_number,'-999')
      WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT', 'FXFORWARD', 'FXNDF') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN concat(esmv.abor_security_number,'-999')
      WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND','FUT_EQT','FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN concat(esmv.abor_security_number,'-999')
      when m.abor_security_type_name='Equity Future' then concat('CPP',cast(esmv.cppib_sec_id as varchar))
      else coalesce(esmv.abor_security_number, concat('CPP',coalesce(cast(ai2.cppib_sec_id as varchar), cast(esmv.cppib_sec_id as varchar))))
 end AS "Underlying_Security_No"

,case WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND','FUT_EQT','FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN concat(esmv.esm_security_name,'-FutureOffset')
      else esmv.esm_security_name
 end AS "Underlying_Security_Name"

,case when m.abor_security_type_name in ('Bond Future','Equity Future') then p.party_name
      when m.abor_security_type_id in ('FXSPOT', 'FXFORWARD', 'FXNDF') then spi.party_name
      when m.abor_security_type_id in ('IRS IR') then spi.party_name
      when m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') then coalesce(p.party_name, spi.party_name)
      else pc.epm_party_name end AS "Underlying_Issuer_Name"

,m.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS "FX_Rate"
,l.balance_nominal "Balance_Nominal"
,CASE WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN (
        'TRSEQ',
        'TRSEQIC',
        'CDS',
        'FXSPOT',
        'FXFORWARD',
        'FXNDF',
        'TRSFIIC',
        'FUT_BOND',
        'FUT_EQT',
        'FUT_IR',
        'IRS IR'
    )
     THEN l.total_market_value_pc 
     ELSE 0 END AS Leg_Exposure_PC 
,case when m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQIC','TRSFIIC','IRS IR','FUT_IR','FUT_BOND','FUT_EQT')
        then coalesce(l.currency_of_exposure_code, l.parent_quoted_currency_code)
        else l.currency_of_exposure_code end AS "Currency_Of_Exposure"
,p.cppib_party_id ID_CPPIBPRTY_ISSR
,m.abor_security_type_name Parent_Security_Type_Name_SCD
,rs.abor_instrument_type_id Parent_Instrument_Type_Name
,coalesce(pgc.name, ' ') Underlying_GICS_Lev_2_Name
,coalesce(case when m.abor_security_type_name in (
     'Credit Default Swap'
     ) then
           date_format(date(und_esmv.esm_maturity_date),'%d/%m/%Y')
     when m.abor_security_type_name in ('Bond Future', 'TRS Fixed Income IC') AND l.leg_no <> 2 then
          date_format(date(esmv.esm_maturity_date),'%d/%m/%Y')
      else date_format(date(m.abor_maturity_date),'%d/%m/%Y') end,' ')  Und_Maturity_Date

from holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough_extended l
left join holdings.scd_holdings_main m 
  on date(m.business_date)=l.business_date 
  and scd_holding_key_id=parent_holding_key
left join reference.scd_securities rs
  on rs.business_date=(select max(business_date) from reference.scd_securities)
  and rs.abor_security_number = m.abor_security_number
left join reference.scd_securities undrs
  on rs.abor_underlying_instrument_id = undrs.scd_security_key_id
  and rs.business_date = undrs.business_date
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite esmv
  on esmv.business_date=l.business_date
  and l.enterprise_security_id = esmv.enterprise_security_id
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite esmvp
  on esmvp.business_date=l.business_date
  and l.parent_cppib_sec_id = cast(esmvp.cppib_sec_id as varchar)
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite und_esmv
  on und_esmv.business_date=l.business_date
  and und_esmv.abor_security_number = undrs.abor_security_number
left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite pc
  on l.business_date = pc.business_date
  and l.enterprise_party_id = pc.enterprise_party_id
left join asset.asset_security_identifiers ai1
  on ai1.business_date=l.business_date
  and cast(ai1.cppib_sec_id as varchar)=l.cppib_sec_id
left join asset.asset_security_identifiers ai2
  on ai2.business_date=l.business_date
  and ai2.scd_id = l.Parent_Security_Name
left join party.party_gics_classifications pgc
  on pgc.business_date=l.business_date
  and cast(pgc.cppib_party_id as varchar) = l.cppib_party_id
  and pgc.level=1
left join party.party p
  on p.business_date=l.business_date
  and cast(p.cppib_party_id as varchar) = l.cppib_party_id
left join party.party pp
  on pp.business_date=l.business_date
  and cast(pp.cppib_party_id as varchar) = esmvp.cppib_party_id
left join risk_prod.cppib_party_rating pr
  on date(pr.business_date)=l.business_date and pr.rating_agency= 'CPPIB'
  and l.cppib_party_id=cast(pr.cppib_party_id as varchar)
left join performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pf
  on date(pf.business_date)=l.business_date
  and pf.model_portfolio = l.id_model_portfolio
  and pf.InvestmentStructure = (select max(distinct InvestmentStructure)
                                   from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten 
                                   where business_date = '2025-05-09'
                                   and InvestmentStructure like 'CPPIB_F%')
